hair.updo: gathered high on the crown in an elegant coiled updo, with two soft locks falling along her cheeks
hair.loose_straight: long, loose and straight, parted softly in the centre, falling freely over both shoulders and down her back in smooth silk-like strands
hair.loose_waves: long, loose and wavy, falling freely over both shoulders in soft glossy waves with a light centre part
hair.bob: cut to a sleek shoulder-length bob with straight side-swept bangs
hair.high_ponytail: a long high ponytail swaying behind her
hair.half_up: long and black, the top half gathered into a small neat knot, the rest falling loose down her back

face.sweet: a soft oval face with a gently tapered chin, large gentle almond eyes, slim softly arched eyebrows, a small refined nose and softly shaped rosy lips, with a faint warm smile
face.heart: a heart-shaped face with a softly pointed chin, large bright almond eyes with long lashes, thin arched eyebrows, a small straight nose and full lips
face.mature: a mature composed face with a slim oval shape, narrow elegant phoenix eyes, defined eyebrows, a high nose bridge and calm closed lips
face.cool: a refined, aloof face with sharp elegant eyes, thin straight eyebrows, a high nose bridge and thin lips with a calm expression

outfit.violet_gauze: an alluring violet outfit in blue-leaning violet, lavender and lilac: a fitted lilac bodice with a scooped neckline and slender shoulder straps leaving her shoulders, collarbones and arms bare; a thin sheer pale-violet chiffon shawl draped loosely over her arms; fine silver filigree trim with small hanging tassels on the bodice; delicate silver chains at the waist; and a long flowing gauze skirt in soft layered violet with a very high side slit showing her bare outer thigh. The bodice and the hip layer under the gauze are solid opaque violet
outfit.white_hanfu: an elegant modest pale white hanfu with a tailored overlapping crossed collar, a fitted opaque bodice, a high waist tied with a plain dark sash, a softly layered skirt and long wide flowing sleeves, in restrained grey ink folds
outfit.ruqun_blue: a pale white ruqun with a short tailored cross-collar blouse fitted over the bust, a high-waisted softly pleated skirt, a narrow light-blue waist ribbon and delicate flowing long sleeves
outfit.black_gold: a fitted black hanfu with a high mandarin collar, wide bishop sleeves, a brocade waist sash with fine gold trim and a flowing ankle-length skirt, fully opaque

pose.clasped_waist: standing relaxed with her body angled slightly, both hands held together gently at her waist
pose.hand_on_chest: standing relaxed with her body angled slightly, one hand resting lightly over her chest and the other arm lowered at her side, a wide sleeve flowing down
pose.hands_behind: standing gracefully with both hands held behind her back, her chest lifted slightly, her head tilted a little to one side
pose.sleeve_lift: standing with her body turned three-quarters to the left, one arm raised gently to shoulder height so the wide sleeve drapes down, the other hand resting at her waist
pose.hair_tuck: standing with her body angled slightly, one hand raised to tuck a lock of hair behind her ear, the other hand resting at her waist
pose.look_back: standing with her body turned three-quarters away and her face looking back over her shoulder toward the viewer, both arms lowered

accessory.jade_flowers_ribbons: a pair of white flower hairpins with small gold leaves clipped on both sides of her head, two long teal-green silk ribbons tied into her hair and flowing down past her shoulders, and matching drop earrings of green jade with gold fittings and a small pearl
accessory.silver_tassel: a slender silver hairpin with small hanging tassels at the crown and long silver drop earrings
accessory.pearl_simple: small round pearl stud earrings and a single slim jade hairpin
accessory.lavender_ribbon: a long pale-lavender silk ribbon tied into her hair and flowing down her back, with small silver filigree drop earrings
accessory.minimal: a single small silver hairpin and small simple silver ear studs
